text: Patient is a 65-year-old male presenting with severe shortness of breath and wheezing. He has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications. Assessment: Acute exacerbation of asthma.
32-year-old female presents with sharp right lower quadrant abdominal pain, nausea, and fever. Appendicitis is suspected. No prior history of hypertension.
Patient was admitted for a fractured right radius after a fall. X-rays confirm a closed torus fracture of the lower end of the right radius. Initial encounter.
